_help: Kingdoms and provinces. A realm is shown in an era only if it has an entry for that era under 'eras'. Fields per era: status, ruler, capital, partOf (id of the realm it belongs to in that era), summary, and optional 'facts' {"Label": "Value"}. 'map' is the name of the province/symbol on the map. Longer texts go into the realm's Markdown 'file' – use one '## <era name>' heading per era. To hide a realm in one era without losing what is written, put an underscore in front of the era name ("_present": {...}); remove the underscore to show it again.
